ca395d166036.curator_note: Friday's edition of the rooftop series you keep coming back to — eight floors over DTLA, sun going down, rotating local house DJs keeping it smooth and skip-free. Free with RSVP, so just walk in early before it caps.
ca395d166036.description: Weekly Friday rooftop house party (5-10pm) at Golden Hour on Level 8 in downtown LA, with rotating local DJs.

a1aee8bcdfae.curator_note: A long-running soulful-electronic night at El Cid for $7 — the kind of low-key, groove-forward room where the selection does the work and nobody's filming. Easy eastside add to a Friday.
a1aee8bcdfae.description: Soulful electronic dance night at El Cid in Silver Lake, doors 10pm, $7.

artist_notes.name: DJ Nuts
artist_notes.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

artist_notes.name: Cut Chemist
artist_notes.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

918a63422186.curator_note: A Mochilla-style 'Like No One Is Watching' digger summit — DJ Nuts and Cut Chemist trading rare grooves with Detroit's Waajeed in the mix. Less peak-time, more for people who care about where the records come from; the Friday move if you'd rather nerd out than rage.
918a63422186.description: Mochilla's 'Like No One Is Watching' all-vinyl global-beats party at 2220 Arts + Archives with DJ Nuts, Waajeed, Cut Chemist and guests; $20.

8d2a98275ab5.curator_note: Vidiots kicks off a Bill Duke weekend with his 1992 LA narco-noir — Laurence Fishburne undercover, Jeff Goldblum sleazy, and an underrated entry in early-'90s Black cinema. Good excuse to finally try the Eagle Rock theater you've been meaning to hit.
8d2a98275ab5.description: Bill Duke's 1992 neo-noir 'Deep Cover' (108 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 7pm, opening a weekend tribute to the director.

artist_notes.name: SHDW
artist_notes.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

2d20ff8e0c2b.curator_note: An all-night-long set from one of modern techno's rhythm specialists, location-TBA-until-two-hours-before like WORK always does it. This is the proper hypnotic-techno end of the weekend — go if you want one DJ taking you the whole way, not the rooftop-groove night.
2d20ff8e0c2b.description: WORK presents German techno DJ SHDW (Mutual Rytm) for an all-night-long set at a location-TBA warehouse in LA, 11pm, tickets from $30.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

0f24a39aa490.curator_note: Bradley Zero headlining a Midnight Lovers open-air day party is about as close to that Sunset Sessions feeling as the weekend gets — sun, disco-leaning house, real selection, no requests. Build Saturday around the 5pm start.
0f24a39aa490.description: Midnight Lovers summer open-air day party at The Bridge with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero plus Masha Mar and LA selectors, from 5pm.

7d0bd069c0e5.curator_note: A sapphic Pride-weekend day party — more community-and-vibes than a billed-DJ night, so it's about the room, not the selection. On the radar if Pride is the priority over the music.
7d0bd069c0e5.description: Sapphic Pride day party 'Hot Girl Summer' at Untamed Spirits, from 3pm, $10.

f44b5d9fe86c.curator_note: Gold Diggers' twice-monthly disco party in East Hollywood — a reliably fun late Saturday for boogie and classic house in an intimate room a short hop from Silver Lake. No headliner billed, but the residents know the format.
f44b5d9fe86c.description: 'The Hustle' first-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

96c73b45a50b.curator_note: A Juneteenth-weekend morning run/wellness gathering at CAAM in Exposition Park — a culture-and-community event, not a music one. Mentioning it for the weekend context, not the lane.
96c73b45a50b.description: Free 'Run The Culture' morning run and community event at the California African American Museum, 9am.

artist_notes.name: Neeko
artist_notes.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

artist_notes.name: Krane
artist_notes.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

cc5a11b4ddb8.curator_note: Sunday Sessions is one of the bigger vinyl-only crews in the country, and this is their open-air Apotheke session — exactly the all-wax, no-laptop house you want closing out a solstice Sunday. Low-key but the real deal.
cc5a11b4ddb8.description: Sunday Sessions LA vinyl-only open-air house session at Apotheke with residents Neeko and Krane, from 6pm.

5dcdfc5a574d.curator_note: Bill Duke was in the cast, which is why Vidiots slots 'Predator' into his weekend — and a 35mm print of the 1987 jungle classic is the right way to see it. Already sold out, so it's a 'if you have a ticket' note.
5dcdfc5a574d.description: John McTiernan's 'Predator' (1987, 107 min) on 35mm at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 3:30pm, as part of the Bill Duke weekend — SOLD OUT.

artist_notes.name: AYYBO
artist_notes.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

artist_notes.name: Ragie Ban
artist_notes.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

6af20e062172.curator_note: The first of a three-night Lake takeover of the park, and the 18+ Friday is the loosest of them — go for the wide-open-field, hands-up version of his sound rather than a tasteful one.
6af20e062172.description: Goldenvoice/Framework present Chris Lake headlining an open-air tech-house party at LA State Historic Park, with AYYBO and Ragie Ban (18+).

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Josh Caffé
artist_notes.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

750cc2565824.curator_note: A location-TBA late one pairing a Detroit lifer with one of the few real vocalists in house — the kind of small, queer-leaning warehouse night that tends to outshine the big rooms this weekend.
750cc2565824.description: Late-night TBA-location house party with Detroit's DJ Minx and London vocalist-DJ Josh Caffé.

artist_notes.name: FARRALONE
artist_notes.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

35bde3a221a0.curator_note: Free-with-RSVP weekly leaning disco and nu-disco — low-stakes and unpretentious, the kind of spot to start a Friday before something bigger rather than make the whole night.
35bde3a221a0.description: Free weekly disco/nu-disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang with residents FARRALONE and Alex D.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer (Dirt Tech Reck, ex-Slum Village camp) — tracked artist; soulful, politically-charged techno and house from the source.

artist_notes.name: Trovarsi
artist_notes.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

artist_notes.name: E.M. Bae
artist_notes.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

artist_notes.name: 92Jelani
artist_notes.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

60356bc699f9.curator_note: A Juneteenth warehouse rave from Black Techno Matters with Waajeed anchoring it — techno reconnected to its Black Detroit roots, which is about the most meaningful way to spend the holiday on a dancefloor.
60356bc699f9.description: Juneteenth warehouse techno party (location TBA) presented by the Black Techno Matters collective, headlined by Detroit's Waajeed.

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

7d3eee612155.curator_note: The strongest night of the Lake run — adding Hot Since 82 gives the open-air a deeper, more European backbone than the Friday, so this is the one to prioritize if you only do one.
7d3eee612155.description: Chris Lake headlines LA State Historic Park with UK house don Hot Since 82 and Club de Combat (Goldenvoice/Framework).

artist_notes.name: Claude VonStroke
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

artist_notes.name: Ardalan
artist_notes.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch and Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Todd Edwards
artist_notes.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

artist_notes.name: Cut Snake
artist_notes.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

artist_notes.name: Falcons
artist_notes.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

367d5cd8ea2a.curator_note: World Cup watch party crossed with a Dirtybird-deep DJ marathon on giant LED screens — a goofy premise on paper, but a genuinely stacked all-day bill that justifies showing up even if you don't care about the football.
367d5cd8ea2a.description: KCRW x Copa Del Rave: an all-day World Cup watch-party-meets-rave at Academy LA with LED match screens and DJs including Claude VonStroke, Todd Edwards, DJ Minx and Ardalan.

artist_notes.name: Ak'chamel, The Giver of Illness
artist_notes.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

artist_notes.name: Derek Monypeny
artist_notes.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

d0dd0d0bf550.curator_note: Not an electronic night at all — this is the heady, masked-ritual psych-folk corner of Zebulon, worth it if you want a left-field listening experience instead of a dancefloor this weekend.
d0dd0d0bf550.description: Experimental psych-folk/drone bill at Zebulon: anonymous Texas duo Ak'chamel, plus Joshua Tree guitarist Derek Monypeny and Kelby Clark.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Rhythm Section International boss out of Peckham — tracked artist; genre-fluid digger (disco, broken beat, deep house) and a touchstone for exactly this rooftop/warehouse-groove taste.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based selector (NTS, dublab; co-founder of Dig Deeper LA) — cosmic disco, tribal and left-field deep house.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

82f9690b2933.curator_note: A 10-hour Bradley Zero session with two of LA's sharpest diggers warming up is the headphones-and-dancing pick of the weekend — build the night around this rather than treating it as a backup.
82f9690b2933.description: Midnight Lovers presents a long-form warehouse party with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero alongside Masha Mar, Xica Soul and Maddy Maia (5pm-3am).

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight and Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic extended sets.

404a1190c380.curator_note: The Sunday/Father's Day cap on the three-night park run — same Lake-and-Hot-Since-82 pairing as Saturday, so pick this only if the weekend night you want is already sold out.
404a1190c380.description: Third date of Chris Lake's LA State Historic Park run with Hot Since 82, an 18+ open-air tech-house party.

artist_notes.name: Cassian
artist_notes.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

artist_notes.name: Kamino
artist_notes.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

2f0dfdae90af.curator_note: Day Trip's daytime melodic-house format in the park, anchored by Cassian — the more emotional, Afterlife-leaning counterweight to the Lake tech-house weekend if peak-time isn't your mood.
2f0dfdae90af.description: Day Trip In The Park daytime melodic/progressive-house party at LA State Historic Park with Cassian, Kamino, Millero and LUMI.

artist_notes.name: Eddie C
artist_notes.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

78348cab1d1a.curator_note: An open-to-close set from Eddie C is exactly the kind of night to plant yourself for — no warmup DJ, no peak-time grandstanding, just one of the slo-mo disco crowd's best diggers building the room all night. Free with RSVP makes it a no-brainer.
78348cab1d1a.description: Eddie C plays an all-night open-to-close set of disco, edits and deep house at Bar Franca.

artist_notes.name: B-Wade
artist_notes.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

4fedbed9168f.curator_note: A recurring soulful-house residency in the back room of Gold Diggers — the warm, vocal, gospel-adjacent end of the spectrum rather than peak-time tools. Good low-key Friday if you want grooves over a big lineup.
4fedbed9168f.description: Recurring all-night soulful-house party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, hosted by resident B-Wade.

bb41161eefe6.curator_note: George Miller's desert-chase masterpiece on the big screen at Vidiots — relentless, practical-stunt insanity that's worth seeing loud and projected rather than at home. Ari's flagged Vidiots as a venue he wants to get into; this is a great excuse.
bb41161eefe6.description: Repertory screening of Mad Max: Fury Road (2015, 121 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock.

artist_notes.name: LYDO
artist_notes.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

artist_notes.name: Frankie Teardrop
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

7aecfa91d404.curator_note: A queer warehouse rave for Pride leaning fast and trance-y — LYDO and Frankie Teardrop are the real-deal underground end of that sound, not a generic circuit party. Skews harder and more peak-time than the rooftop-groove lane, so go in for the energy, not for selection.
7aecfa91d404.description: Location-TBA Pride warehouse party with queer-underground techno from LYDO, Frankie Teardrop, Miracles and J.dB.

artist_notes.name: Tamara Lanza
artist_notes.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

2353e1ad635b.curator_note: The pool-party edition of Sunset Sessions — the rooftop-vinyl-house series at Level 8 that's basically Ari's reference point for a good open-air Saturday. The lineup's local-resident rather than a marquee guest, but the setting and sound are the whole reason to go.
2353e1ad635b.description: Saturday afternoon pool-party edition of the Sunset Sessions rooftop house series at Level 8 DTLA, with Aplex, Tamara Lanza and Electric Field.

image.credit: Sunset Sessions / Golden Hour DTLA (official series listing)

artist_notes.name: Antal
artist_notes.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

ec2ca5e297c2.curator_note: We Own The Night marks 15 years of its no-velvet-ropes 'real LA underground rare house' parties by flying Antal in from Amsterdam for an extended set — that's a serious pairing of crowd and selector, and exactly the dirty-disco-into-house energy worth chasing a TBA address for.
ec2ca5e297c2.description: We Own The Night's 15-year anniversary at a TBA downtown location, with an extended set from Rush Hour's Antal flying in from Amsterdam.

artist_notes.name: Reverberation Radio
artist_notes.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

169931f6acf3.curator_note: Not a four-on-the-floor night — this is the Allah-Las' crate-digging crew spinning psych, surf, library and global oddities off vinyl at Zebulon. A great listening-bar-flavored hang if you want grooves and discovery instead of a dancefloor.
169931f6acf3.description: Allah-Las' Reverberation Radio crew DJ a night of vintage psych, surf and global vinyl obscurities at Zebulon in Frogtown.

cbf00da01c90.curator_note: A morning camera-and-coffee meetup for the photo/video crowd — gear talk, coffee and shooting, not a music thing. Off the main lane unless Ari's specifically into the photography-community side.
cbf00da01c90.description: Free morning photography/videographer community meetup (gear + coffee) hosted by Dangycam; address drops after RSVP approval.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

artist_notes.name: john gerrard
artist_notes.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

deede894fa33.curator_note: A free summer-solstice dance at LACMA pairing Richie Hawtin with John Gerrard's 'SPIRITS' artwork — Hawtin in a museum-plaza art context rather than a club, so expect something more textural and hypnotic than a peak-time techno hammer. Worth it for the name and the setting; RSVP required.
deede894fa33.description: Free summer-solstice dance at LACMA with a techno set from Richie Hawtin, tied to artist john gerrard's 'SPIRITS' installation.

artist_notes.name: Dave Harrington
artist_notes.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

artist_notes.name: John Dwyer
artist_notes.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

artist_notes.name: Spencer Zahn
artist_notes.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

artist_notes.name: Aaron Steele
artist_notes.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

artist_notes.name: Tom Dolas
artist_notes.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

e00ad8085b0c.curator_note: A one-off improvising quintet built around Dave Harrington (Darkside) and Oh Sees' John Dwyer at Zebulon — heady, psych-leaning instrumental jamming rather than songs. Squarely in the experimental-band lane Ari wants surfaced, and Zebulon's the perfect room for it.
e00ad8085b0c.description: One-night improvising quintet — Dave Harrington (Darkside), John Dwyer (Oh Sees), Aaron Steele, Spencer Zahn and Tom Dolas — at Zebulon in Frogtown.

4dd13aaa260f.title: HARD Summer Music Festival

artist_notes.name: Charlotte de Witte
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno headliner — hypnotic, acid-inflected, driving sets; one of the genre's biggest names right now. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian, Lenske Records — hard, fast, relentless techno. A guaranteed highlight on any multi-stage lineup. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: DJ Seinfeld
artist_notes.note: Swedish (Armand Jakobsson) — lo-fi, hazy, romance-tinged house with a distinctive nostalgic texture. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: Mau P
artist_notes.note: Dutch — 'drum-tool' tech-house that bridges underground technique with festival-scale crowd energy. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: Chris Lorenzo
artist_notes.note: Bristol-born tech-house producer; raw, grimy British sound, strong DJ sets. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian melodic tech-house festival mainstay — slick, emotive, reliably crowd-moving. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: Anetha
artist_notes.note: French techno DJ and founder of Mama Club collective — raw, industrial-leaning sets; a solid underground name in a mainstream lineup.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Polish DJ/producer (Martyna Maja) — fast, aggressive, EBM-inflected techno; Possession and INTRVL records. A legitimate underground pick here.

artist_notes.name: Brutalismus 3000
artist_notes.note: Berlin duo known for speed-distorted techno and EBM hybrids — a genuinely abrasive, interesting corner of the lineup.

artist_notes.name: Maceo Plex
artist_notes.note: Cuban-American melodic/dark techno veteran (Ellum Audio) — reliable festival draw with deeper cred than most on this bill.

artist_notes.name: Luuk van Dijk
artist_notes.note: Dutch DJ/producer — peak-hour tech-house and house; Insomniac/Extended family orbit.

artist_notes.name: Interplanetary Criminal
artist_notes.note: UK DJ/producer — big-room tech-house with hip-hop vocal cuts; festival-circuit star.

4dd13aaa260f.curator_note: Two days, Hollywood Park, August heat — HARD Summer is at its best when you treat it as a techno/tech-house buffet and skip the EDM stages entirely. Charlotte de Witte and Amelie Lens are the obvious reasons to go; VTSS and Anetha are the finds.
4dd13aaa260f.description: Two-day electronic music festival at Hollywood Park (adjacent to SoFi Stadium) with 60+ artists across multiple stages, anchored by Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens, and a broad spectrum from Belgian techno to festival tech-house.

bb4f346b7a87.title: Day Trip Festival Long Beach

artist_notes.name: Loco Dice
artist_notes.note: Tunisian-German DJ/producer, Desolat label co-founder — funky, raw tech-house with Ibiza credibility; a longer-running underground name on this bill.

artist_notes.name: Adam Beyer
artist_notes.note: Swedish founder of Drumcode Records — driving, precise techno; one of the genre's most prolific label bosses. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: Hi-Lo
artist_notes.note: Oliver Heldens' techno alias; the Dutch house star goes darker and harder under HILOMATIK — a genuine genre-pivot, not just a rebrand.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: UK-born, now LA-based (Dave Bissett) — Hellbent Records founder, groove-heavy tech-house. Currently resident in the LA scene.

artist_notes.name: Elderbrook
artist_notes.note: English vocalist/producer (Alexander Kotz) — best known for 'Cola' with CamelPhat; melodic, vocal-driven house that works at festival scale.

artist_notes.name: Hayden James
artist_notes.note: Sydney-based producer (Future Classic) — emotive, hook-driven melodic house; large following in the Rufus Du Sol adjacent lane.

artist_notes.name: Sidepiece
artist_notes.note: US duo (Party Favor + Nitti Gritti) — high-energy tech-house/bass house, Grammy-nominated; Spotify core rotation for Ari.

artist_notes.name: Westend
artist_notes.note: NYC-based tech-house producer (Tyler Morris; Repopulate Mars, Dirtybird) — chart-topping festival tools including a Beatport #1 flip of 'Keep On Jumpin'.

artist_notes.name: Greg 99
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and producer in the tech-house/house circuit; local scene fixture.

artist_notes.name: Riordan
artist_notes.note: Spotify core-rotation artist for Ari — included per the scoring signal; bio not verified independently.

bb4f346b7a87.curator_note: Day Trip has earned its rep as the more curated Insomniac festival, and the Queen Mary waterfront is genuinely a better outdoor setting than most LA options. The Loco Dice / Adam Beyer pairing on one stage is the reason to go; the Sidepiece B2B Westend set is the fun, crowd-pleasing counterweight.
bb4f346b7a87.description: Two-day 21+ electronic festival at the Queen Mary Waterfront in Long Beach (June 27–28), with a new 11,000-cap amphitheater stage, anchored by Adam Beyer, Loco Dice, Hi-Lo, and Cloonee.

9ea5376be5a4.title: Lights Down Low feat Yaeji

artist_notes.name: Yaeji
artist_notes.note: Korean-American singer/DJ/producer (XL Recordings) — blends house, lo-fi hip-hop and soft-spoken bilingual vocals into something genuinely singular. Tracked. This is a DJ set, not a live show.

artist_notes.name: Alima Lee
artist_notes.note: NYC/LA filmmaker and DJ, hosts 'Rave Reparations' monthly on NTS (Akashik Records co-founder) — eclectic techno and house with a deliberate focus on Black and queer artists in the scene.

artist_notes.name: Hu Dat
artist_notes.note: LA-born open-format DJ (hip-hop, R&B focus) — not the house/techno lane; warming up the crowd before Yaeji.

9ea5376be5a4.curator_note: Lights Down Low consistently books artists who don't do standard club appearances, and Yaeji at a TBA downtown warehouse is exactly that — her DJ sets are looser and weirder than the records suggest. Go for Yaeji, stay for however Alima Lee frames the room.
9ea5376be5a4.description: Lights Down Low's TBA-location afterhours party with Yaeji headlining a DJ set alongside Alima Lee, Hu Dat, and AMERICANRECYCLING; doors 10pm, $22–46.

d535a0dbfe40.title: Factory 93 presents: Amelie Lens at Grand Park Block 2

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian founder of Lenske Records — hard, high-energy driving techno, one of the genre's most in-demand acts. The billing says she'll span techno, acid, and trance across an extended day-to-dusk set. Tracked.

d535a0dbfe40.curator_note: An extended outdoor Amelie Lens set from 5pm at Grand Park is a rare format for her LA appearances — Factory 93 at the park skips the warehouse and gives you Belgian techno under the DTLA skyline. Book it for September now.
d535a0dbfe40.description: Factory 93 presents Amelie Lens for an extended day-to-dusk set spanning techno, acid, and trance at Gloria Molina Grand Park in DTLA, 5–11pm.

58579f941eb8.title: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO present: Stacey Pullen, BAE BAE and Nish

artist_notes.name: Stacey Pullen
artist_notes.note: Detroit second-wave techno pioneer (Blackflag Records; Derrick May protégé) — atmospheric, groove-driven techno built on the Motor City blueprint. A tracked name and a genuine reason to chase the TBA address.

artist_notes.name: BAE BAE
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer, founder of NEGRESS and Hood Rave — eclectic selector spanning R&B, house, jungle, garage, and dancehall, centering Black femme artists. An essential voice in the city's queer club scene.

artist_notes.name: nish.
artist_notes.note: LA-based (INCOGNITO resident), raised between LA and the Philippines — soulful house, jazz-house, garage and afro-leaning sets; a strong warm-up voice for this lineup.

58579f941eb8.curator_note: Dirty Epic + INCOGNITO know how to frame a Detroit techno legend without making it a museum piece — the BAE BAE pairing brings real DTLA queer-underground energy to the room. Stacey Pullen at a TBA location on a Friday is the kind of thing you regret skipping.
58579f941eb8.description: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO co-present Detroit techno legend Stacey Pullen with LA selectors BAE BAE and nish. at a TBA-location afterhours party, 11pm, $27–32.

0f729582faa3.title: WORK presents: Robert Hood, Disco Zombie, Ønyx, & Rubbermiro

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal techno founder (M-Plant Records; ex-Underground Resistance with Jeff Mills and Mad Mike Banks) — stripped, functional, spiritual techno from the source. A tracked name. July 4 afterhours with Robert Hood is not to be slept on.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ, hosts 'earlyafters' on KCHUNG Radio — dark, groovy sets; a Dirty Epic regular and embedded in the city's underground circuit.

artist_notes.name: Ønyx
artist_notes.note: LA-area electronic artist with French and Middle Eastern roots — limited public footprint beyond RA profile and local appearances; included per the billing.

0f729582faa3.curator_note: Robert Hood doing a July 4th TBA-location warehouse night is exactly the kind of thing WORK does right — minimal, stripped, no pyro. This is the anti-fireworks option, and it's the better one.
0f729582faa3.description: WORK presents Robert Hood (Detroit, M-Plant) for a late-night TBA-location warehouse set with LA techno selectors Rubbermiro and Ønyx; 11pm–6am, $24–35+.

7e00f46a7221.title: Jayda G

artist_notes.name: Jayda G
artist_notes.note: Canadian-born, London-based (Ninja Tune; Butter Sessions) — Grammy-nominated for 'Both of Us,' her sound fuses vintage drum-machine funk, Chicago house, and disco with genuine scientific rigor (she has an environmental toxicology MSc). A tracked name. Sound Nightclub is the right room for her.

7e00f46a7221.curator_note: Jayda G at Sound on July 4th is the deep-house-and-disco alternative to everything louder happening that weekend — she's one of the few people who makes disco house feel like a real genre argument rather than a throwback set.
7e00f46a7221.description: Jayda G plays Sound Nightclub in Hollywood for a deep house and disco set, 10pm–3am, $31.

241179720c5f.title: Robert Hood, Disco Zombie, Onyx, & Rubbermiro

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal techno founder (M-Plant Records; ex-Underground Resistance) — stripped, functional techno. Tracked. Note: this appears to be the same event as the WORK/RA listing (id: 0f729582faa3), captured separately via 19hz.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio 'earlyafters' host) — dark, groovy techno; Dirty Epic regular.

artist_notes.name: Ønyx
artist_notes.note: LA-area electronic artist; limited verifiable bio beyond local event appearances.

241179720c5f.curator_note: This appears to be the same WORK-presents Robert Hood event as the RA listing — two source captures of the same July 4th TBA warehouse night. The 19hz entry adds the 6AM Group / Synthetik Minds / Work organizer context, confirming the underground crew behind it.
241179720c5f.description: WORK, 6AM Group, and Synthetik Minds present Robert Hood with Rubbermiro and Ønyx (and Disco Zombie) at a TBA-location LA warehouse, 11pm–6am — likely same event as the RA WORK listing.

52241f8a3d48.title: HARD Summer Music Festival

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian, Lenske Records — driving, high-energy techno. Tracked. Also on Day 1.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Polish DJ/producer (Martyna Maja) — fast EBM-inflected techno; Possession records. Underground credibility in a big-room slot.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian festival tech-house/melodic house mainstay. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: German producer/DJ (Boys Noize Records) — electro, techno and acid; long-standing underground-to-mainstream bridge figure.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ/producer (Turbo Recordings) — electro-house and synth-pop adjacent; 'Sunglasses At Night' etc. A veteran with genuine taste.

artist_notes.name: Brutalismus 3000
artist_notes.note: Berlin EBM/techno hybrid duo — speed and abrasion; one of the more genuinely challenging names on this bill.

artist_notes.name: Knock2
artist_notes.note: US producer — peak-hour tech-house with pop-crossover instincts; large streaming footprint.

52241f8a3d48.curator_note: Day 2 of HARD Summer has slightly tighter electronic programming than Day 1 — Amelie Lens again, VTSS for the underground heads, Boys Noize and Tiga for the electro-curious. If you're only doing one day, check the stage times across both before committing.
52241f8a3d48.description: Day 2 of HARD Summer Music Festival at Hollywood Park, Inglewood, with Amelie Lens, Boys Noize, Vintage Culture, VTSS, Tiga, and Knock2 among the headliners.

e667ba3ea44d.title: LA DISCOTECA
e667ba3ea44d.curator_note: Free afterhours disco/electronic party at the Slipper Clutch — a small, no-frills DTLA speakeasy-ish bar. No lineup billed publicly; the Instagram source (@ravenousdreams) suggests a local residents affair. Low-effort entry point for a Friday if you want to stay DTLA.
e667ba3ea44d.description: Free afterhours electronic/disco party at The Slipper Clutch in DTLA, 9pm–2am, presented by Ravenous Dreams — no lineup announced publicly.

a2ec0d8dd081.title: CSW and SLINK - Enayet and K Wata [All Night] [Live / DJ]

artist_notes.name: Enayet
artist_notes.note: SLINK co-founder and NYC-based Bangladeshi producer/DJ — deep soundsystem pressure rooted in Dhaka field recordings, dub techno and febrile club rhythms. Released 'Bhir' on SLINK; operates in the same experimental-club space as Eartheater or Actress.

artist_notes.name: K Wata
artist_notes.note: SLINK co-founder (Kenzo Perron) and Lot Radio resident — dubwise, slow-motion bass music drawing on Memphis/Houston trap and click-n-cut sampling. Has releases on the SLINK label. Brings a heavy, textural counterweight to Enayet's rhythmic density.

a2ec0d8dd081.curator_note: Canary Sound Werk and SLINK — two of LA and NYC's most low-key serious underground crews — collabing on an all-night live/DJ set is genuinely interesting. This is deep, dubwise and not designed to please; go if you want to be challenged, not serviced.
a2ec0d8dd081.description: CSW and SLINK present SLINK co-founders Enayet and K Wata for an all-night live/DJ set at a TBA downtown location, 10pm.

4b5718ac6609.title: MARBLE: Halo Varga, Dylan Payne, Hazy, PabloDiscobar

artist_notes.name: Halo Varga
artist_notes.note: Chicago-rooted, globally-touring house/techno producer (Chicago-to-San Francisco trajectory) — releases on Large, Soma, Yoshitoshi and Nordic Trax. Vintage drum machine sounds mixed with organic rhythms; veteran festival and club selector with IDMA nominations in the mid-2000s. Competent but not a needle-mover for this taste.

artist_notes.name: Krane
artist_notes.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ; see prior cache entry.

4b5718ac6609.curator_note: Marble throws reliably solid arts-district afterhours with a large rotating cast — more about the room and the crowd than any one marquee name. Halo Varga is a seasoned selector but this is a B-list Friday night, not a destination one.
4b5718ac6609.description: Marble and Melt Collective co-present a six-DJ afterhours at a TBA Arts District location with Halo Varga, Dylan Payne, Hazy, PabloDiscobar, Krane and Highkin'.

fd9f6e2edd10.title: Flying Mojito Bros, Brainstory

artist_notes.name: Flying Mojito Bros
artist_notes.note: UK duo (Ben Chetwood + Jack Sellen) doing desert disco and outlaw house — cosmic country funk and classic rock records routed through NYC disco and baggy acid house. Releases on Heavenly, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Ubiquity; Glastonbury, Stagecoach and Pikes Ibiza credits. One of the more genuinely unusual sounds on the weekend's bill.

artist_notes.name: Brainstory
artist_notes.note: LA-based psych-soul trio (Kevin and Tony Martin + Eric Hagstrom) signed to Big Crown Records — jazzy, Hendrix-and-Mayfield-influenced soul with bossa and afro-latin groove. Live band, not a DJ; produced by Leon Michels. Fits the 'live-band-room' lane the taste profile explicitly wants surfaced.

fd9f6e2edd10.curator_note: Desert Daze's Bellwether takeover pairs a live psychedelic-soul band with a UK duo doing cosmic country-into-disco — Camille's is a new Prince-honoring space inside the venue, intimate and worth trying on its own. An unusual blend that leans more Balearic daydream than peak-time.
fd9f6e2edd10.description: Desert Daze night at Camille's (The Bellwether) with live psych-soul trio Brainstory and DJ set from UK desert-disco duo Flying Mojito Bros, 9pm–2am, $24.

039b68263b20.title: Stacey Pullen, Bae Bae and Nish

artist_notes.name: Stacey Pullen
artist_notes.note: Detroit techno second-wave figure — studied under Derrick May, runs Blackflag Records, delivered the Fabric 14 mix in 2004 and Detroit Love on Carl Craig's Planet E. His sound fuses house and garage into a tribal-tinged techno framework. Tracked artist in taste.yaml; billed for a 3-hour set here.

artist_notes.name: Bae Bae
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ, producer and multidisciplinary artist — eclectically mixes R&B, club, house, jungle, UK garage and dancehall, centering Black femme independent artists in her selections. Support slot, but an interesting contrast to the Pullen techno headliner.

039b68263b20.curator_note: Stacey Pullen doing a 3-hour set with Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO is exactly the kind of Detroit-lineage techno night this taste asks for — underground, proper, 11pm–5am at a TBA warehouse. The support billing (Bae Bae) is genre-eclectically interesting rather than filler.
039b68263b20.description: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO present Detroit techno veteran Stacey Pullen (3-hour set) with Bae Bae and Nish at a TBA location, 11pm–5am, 21+.

61cf97428297.title: The Groove
61cf97428297.curator_note: Free Friday afterhours from Qream City at 330 S Broadway — no billed lineup, so this is a walk-in if the other DTLA nights don't pan out. The Qream City branding suggests a queer-leaning room, but specifics are thin.
61cf97428297.description: Free late-night house and groove party presented by Qream City at 330 S Broadway in DTLA, 10pm.

da4e3fe70e19.title: discostan

artist_notes.name: discostan
artist_notes.note: LA collective (Arshia Haq + Jeremy Loudenback) founded in 2011 — crate-digging across the Arab world, the Subcontinent, Iran, North Africa and diaspora pop, framed as 'the imaginary migratory homeland.' Not a dance-music-as-usual proposition; vinyl-heavy global selection, community-first. Regularly on RA and documented in Mixmag as a key South Asian diaspora dance collective.

artist_notes.name: Kohinoorgasm
artist_notes.note: LA-based South Asian queer artist (Josephine Shetty) — 'azaadi pop fairy' making experimental electro-pop with synthy beats, echoing vocals and minimalist techno touches. Releases on Bandcamp; operates at the lo-fi experimental pop end rather than peak-time dance.

da4e3fe70e19.curator_note: Discostan at El Cid is a rare thing — a DJ night genuinely organized around politics, diaspora, and crate-digging the broader Islamic-influenced musical world rather than genre categories. Worth going curious rather than expecting a straight house night.
da4e3fe70e19.description: El Cid hosts Chivalry's night featuring discostan (LA's South Asian/SWANA diaspora collective) and queer experimental artist Kohinoorgasm, Saturday from 9:30pm, $11–17.

4d5f11e375f5.title: Butterground: Pocari G, Ashtre, Costa, Oso Disco, Blaze Claze

artist_notes.name: Oso Disco
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and Camp Butter resident — deep house and disco selector in the eastside underground orbit; recurring name on the local TBA-location circuit.

4d5f11e375f5.curator_note: Camp Butter's Butterground is a reliable Saturday house night for the DTLA underground crowd — a five-DJ rotating cast, TBA address, $25 and done by 4am. No marquee name but a solid option if you want house without ceremony.
4d5f11e375f5.description: Camp Butter and Anna Argente present Butterground: a five-DJ Saturday house night at a TBA DTLA location with Pocari G, Ashtre, Costa, Oso Disco and Blaze Claze, 10pm–4am, $25.

a686cbd059dc.title: INLAND GROOVE AFTER HOURS
a686cbd059dc.curator_note: Inland Groove is an Inland Empire-rooted collective bringing underground house to DTLA TBA spaces — free entry makes the unknown lineup a low-stakes option, but with two stronger Saturday house nights competing for the same slot, this is the fallback.
a686cbd059dc.description: Inland Groove after-hours house party at a TBA DTLA location, free entry from 11pm.

c272d34d687c.title: Inland Groove After Hours
c272d34d687c.curator_note: Duplicate listing of the same Inland Groove Saturday after-hours via 19hz — same event as the Posh listing (id: a686cbd059dc). Free before 1am / $10 after per this source.
c272d34d687c.description: Inland Groove after-hours house night at a TBA DTLA location, free with RSVP before 1am / $10 after, 11pm–5am.

f4fe507771f1.title: Groove Room: A House and Hits Dance Party
f4fe507771f1.curator_note: Gold Diggers' recurring house-and-hits format in their intimate East Hollywood room — no guest billed, resident-only, which makes it a reliable low-key option for the July 4th-eve Friday. Short hop from Silver Lake, DICE ticketed.
f4fe507771f1.description: Recurring house and dance-floor-hits night at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm, no headliner listed.

00bfe8a0d235.title: GOOD GAME

artist_notes.name: GG (5)
artist_notes.note: GG is the host/DJ behind Good Game at Townhouse Venice — billing describes deep cuts, deep house, hip-hop and global rhythms, but she has a minimal public footprint and I can't verify a bio beyond the event copy. Taking the event's own description at face value; confidence low on the artist specifically.

00bfe8a0d235.curator_note: A Friday-night hang at one of Venice's oldest bars — the 'deep cuts and deeper vibrations' pitch is appealing but the billing is thin (no marquee name, just GG and friends). Worth knowing if you're already on the westside, less worth a special trip.
00bfe8a0d235.description: Good Game is a late-night DJ party at Townhouse Venice hosted by GG, mixing deep house, hip-hop and global rhythms, starting at 10pm.

c56c321b3412.title: Ginger Root

artist_notes.name: Ginger Root
artist_notes.note: Cameron Lew's solo project out of Huntington Beach — alt-disco, city pop and boogie filtered through his Asian-American lens, drawing on '70s-'80s Japanese city pop and Philly soul in equal measure. His 2024 album SHINBANGUMI is on Ghostly International. More live-band groove than DJ set.

c56c321b3412.curator_note: Ginger Root at Camille's is a live-band disco-and-city-pop show, not a DJ night — if you want something warm and groove-forward that isn't four-on-the-floor, Lew's act is genuinely fun and the free door makes it a zero-friction Friday add.
c56c321b3412.description: Ginger Root (Cameron Lew's indie disco / city pop project, signed to Ghostly International) plays Camille's at The Bellwether, free, 8pm.

d26b1c2aec3d.title: The Hustle ~ First and Third Saturday Disco Party!
d26b1c2aec3d.curator_note: The recurring Gold Diggers disco residency — no guest billed, but the format is reliably fun and the East Hollywood location is a short hop from Silver Lake. A Fourth of July late-night option for boogie and classic house in a small, no-fuss room.
d26b1c2aec3d.description: The Hustle is Gold Diggers' twice-monthly Saturday disco and boogie party in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

9412d5b2209e.title: Midnight Lovers: Eli Escobar

artist_notes.name: Eli Escobar
artist_notes.note: New York house and disco selector with over two decades in the NYC club scene — co-founder of Tiki Disco, runs the Night People NYC label, and has released on Razor-N-Tape, Defected's Classic imprint, and Phonica. Warm, well-versed NYC house energy that fits the Midnight Lovers format well.

9412d5b2209e.curator_note: Midnight Lovers' TBA downtown series is consistently well-curated, and landing a NYC selector like Eli Escobar on the Fourth of July weekend is a smart get — expect a house-and-disco room that earns its late finish without ever getting bro-y about it.
9412d5b2209e.description: Midnight Lovers presents NYC house and disco selector Eli Escobar at a TBA downtown LA location, 7pm-2am, $22 advance.

9fd90f37b8e7.title: The Roamers

artist_notes.name: The Roamers
artist_notes.note: LA-based rock band formed in 2023 by Matt Rice — self-described Americana-influenced rock with dive-bar roots; debut album released 2024. Scored as electronic on RA, but the Redwood Bar hosts primarily rock and indie acts. Confidence low on genre match with this taste profile.

9fd90f37b8e7.curator_note: The Redwood Bar is a rock dive, and The Roamers appear to be an Americana-leaning rock band — the RA 'electronic' tag looks like a mislabel. This one doesn't map to the lane; skip unless you want a casual DTLA bar night with zero pressure.
9fd90f37b8e7.description: The Roamers, an LA rock band, play The Redwood Bar and Grill in DTLA at 8pm.

5b8636a94da3.title: Lost in Dreams Los Angeles

artist_notes.name: Dabin
artist_notes.note: Korean-Canadian melodic bass and future bass producer (Seeking Blue, True) — emotive, drop-focused festival electronic with ODESZA adjacency.

artist_notes.name: Louis the Child
artist_notes.note: Chicago production duo (Robby Hauldren and Freddy Kennett) known for feel-good indie-electronic and festival-circuit collaborations.

artist_notes.name: What So Not
artist_notes.note: Sydney-born producer and former Flume collaborator — festival-grade future bass and cross-genre electronic, regularly on the Coachella/HARD circuit.

artist_notes.name: ARMNHMR
artist_notes.note: LA electronic duo specializing in melodic bass and future bass; strong draw with the Porter Robinson fanbase.

5b8636a94da3.curator_note: Lost in Dreams is Insomniac's melodic-bass festival and the Porter Robinson DJ set is the draw — that's the Spotify-rotation name here, but the surrounding lineup (future bass, melodic progressive) leans younger and bigger-room than the usual preference. Worth flagging for the Porter set; approach with adjusted expectations for the rest.
5b8636a94da3.description: Lost in Dreams 2026 is a two-day Insomniac melodic-bass festival at LA State Historic Park (July 11-12) headlined by Porter Robinson DJ set, plus Dabin, Louis the Child, Audien, What So Not and more.

9a0fd9893571.title: Information - All Vinyl Night w/ Taylor Shockley + Luke Mele + CHOÍCE

artist_notes.name: Taylor Shockley
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-based DJ specializing in all-vinyl mixes spanning ambient, minimal, dub and house — a deliberate, textural selector whose mixes run slow and deep. NTS and Dublab adjacency.

artist_notes.name: Luke Mele
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and NTS host with an eclectic Balearic sensibility — house, disco, trip-hop, dub techno and ambient in a single set; a proper digger's digger in the Frogtown/Silver Lake scene.

artist_notes.name: CHOÍCE
artist_notes.note: Could not verify a bio for this artist — included per the billing, confidence low on context.

9a0fd9893571.curator_note: Information's all-vinyl format in a TBA DTLA room is exactly the listening-bar energy the taste is drawn to — Shockley and Mele are both slow-burn, texture-first selectors who'd be right at home on a late NTS show. The address-drops-later format is the only friction.
9a0fd9893571.description: Information presents an all-vinyl late-night DJ session at a TBA Downtown LA location with Taylor Shockley, Luke Mele and CHOÍCE, 10pm.

0eb89ce23c2b.title: Certified Groovers with Demuir

artist_notes.name: Demuir
artist_notes.note: Toronto-based house DJ and producer — funk and groove-forward jackin house with releases on Hot Creations, Desolat and his own Purveyor Underground imprint. Accessible and soulful rather than tool-y; fits the groove end of the tech-house spectrum.

0eb89ce23c2b.curator_note: Certified Groovers consistently books quality selectors for its TBA downtown warehouse format, and Demuir's groove-first house sits comfortably between the Hot Creations feel-good end and something deeper. Solid late-summer Friday if the address reveals a good room.
0eb89ce23c2b.description: Certified Groovers presents Toronto-based house DJ and producer Demuir at a TBA Downtown Los Angeles warehouse, 10pm.

8a862e604d08.title: Midnight Lovers with Massimiliano Pagliara, Masha Mar, James Axon

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Italian-in-Berlin DJ and producer, Berghain/Panorama Bar resident — eclectic across house, disco, electro and techno, with albums on Ostgut Ton and Permanent Vacation (See You in Paradise won the German Record Critics' Award in 2022). Deep European pedigree, exactly the fabric/Panorama-Bar energy the taste wants.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ, Dublab resident and founder of the queer underground Planet Love party — a lifelong pianist turned obsessive record collector who moves seamlessly through house, italo, disco, electro and breaks. One of the better deep-digging selectors in the local scene.

8a862e604d08.curator_note: Massimiliano Pagliara is a genuine Panorama Bar resident whose records on Ostgut Ton speak for themselves — getting him into a Midnight Lovers room with James Axon and Masha Mar is a proper European-leaning disco-house lineup, not a hype booking. September gives it a nice 'end-of-summer' weight.
8a862e604d08.description: Midnight Lovers presents Berghain/Panorama Bar resident Massimiliano Pagliara alongside LA selectors Masha Mar and James Axon at The Bridge, DTLA, 9pm.

3061917831bd.title: Certified Groovers: Gene On Earth in LA

artist_notes.name: Gene On Earth
artist_notes.note: California-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer — founder of the Limousine Dream label, whose warm, sun-soaked minimal house sound bridges the California outdoors with the Berlin underground. His 2022 album Time on the Vine is the clearest statement of that; touches of techno and drum & bass expand the palette on newer releases.

3061917831bd.curator_note: Gene On Earth's Limousine Dream aesthetic — hazy, warm, minimal house that feels like driving the California coast at dusk — is a natural fit for the Certified Groovers TBA warehouse format. A late-September booking that should hit differently than the summer rush.
3061917831bd.description: Certified Groovers presents Berlin-based house DJ and Limousine Dream label founder Gene On Earth at a TBA Downtown Los Angeles warehouse, 10pm.

50e6547bec06.title: An American in Paris
50e6547bec06.curator_note: Vincente Minnelli's 1951 Gershwin spectacular — Gene Kelly dancing through a 17-minute ballet sequence that still holds up as pure cinema craft. A good Tuesday afternoon at Vidiots.
50e6547bec06.description: Repertory screening of Vincente Minnelli's Oscar-winning 1951 musical 'An American in Paris,' starring Gene Kelly and Leslie Caron, at Vidiots in Eagle Rock.

1e27960536ad.title: Recollect Underground: JTJ, Kenny Cordeiro, Matt Marauder, Lavenge B2B Xuliet, Mama J B2B Max Rush

artist_notes.name: JTJ
artist_notes.note: LA underground selector billed at the top of Recollect's regular afterhours; limited public footprint outside the local TBA-location circuit — included per the billing.

artist_notes.name: Kenny Cordeiro
artist_notes.note: Recollect Underground regular; local minimal/tech-house DJ in the DTLA afterhours scene — couldn't verify additional bio details.

artist_notes.name: Matt Marauder
artist_notes.note: Local LA afterhours DJ associated with the Recollect/underground tech-house circuit; limited public record.

artist_notes.name: Lavenge
artist_notes.note: Local LA selector; billed B2B at Recollect Underground — no verified bio beyond the underground circuit listing.

artist_notes.name: Mama J
artist_notes.note: Recollect Underground affiliate; B2B billing here; limited public footprint.

1e27960536ad.curator_note: Recollect does the DTLA TBA-location afterhours format properly — location drops via IG the night of, 11pm–5am, $11.50 early. The bill is deep in locals, which keeps it intimate and self-selecting. Good if you want a rolling minimal night without the festival-scale production.
1e27960536ad.description: Recollect Underground's weekly location-TBA afterhours in DTLA running 11pm–5am, with local tech-house and minimal DJs including JTJ, Kenny Cordeiro, Matt Marauder and two B2B sets.

c0b91fb54504.title: Stavros Halkias: The Dreamboat Tour

artist_notes.name: Stavros Halkias
artist_notes.note: Greek-American stand-up on a massive 2026 run — 'The Dreamboat Tour' is his biggest yet; he's also in Yorgos Lanthimos' Bugonia and leads Netflix's Tires (renewed for season 3). In your comedians_loved list for good reason.

c0b91fb54504.curator_note: The one time comedy makes the digest — Stavros at the Wiltern is a Friday-night-sized show from a comedian who earns it. Grab it before it sells.
c0b91fb54504.description: Stavros Halkias brings 'The Dreamboat Tour' to the Wiltern in Koreatown for a Friday night stand-up show.

31d6a23bb826.title: SUNSET SESSIONS presents: 'Unicorns-Only' Takeover

artist_notes.name: Casmalia
artist_notes.note: LA-based producer and DJ behind the 'Unicorns Only' underground-focused monthly — releases on Insomniac, mau5trap, Night Bass and CUFF, with support from FISHER and John Summit. This is her curated takeover of the Sunset Sessions rooftop slot, pitched as 'underground, the stuff you won't hear on a mainstage.'

31d6a23bb826.curator_note: The regular Sunset Sessions rooftop formula but with Casmalia's Unicorns-Only underground filter applied — same free-entry Level 8 golden hour, different selector philosophy than the usual residents. Worth showing up early.
31d6a23bb826.description: Sunset Sessions' Friday rooftop at Level 8 DTLA gets a special 'Unicorns-Only' edition curated by LA house/tech-house DJ-producer Casmalia, 5pm, free.

437b015f697a.title: Midnight Lovers with JKriv (Razor-N-Tape)

artist_notes.name: JKriv
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-based co-founder of Razor-N-Tape — the disco-and-house edits label with 150+ releases over 12 years, called 'an innovator of the scene' by Defected's Simon Dunmore. He's also guitarist in live disco band Escort. Sets weave eclectic disco, house and offbeat selections with an ear for groove — exactly the Midnight Lovers register.

437b015f697a.curator_note: Razor-N-Tape is one of the best disco-house edit labels running, and JKriv is the guy who built it. Free entry at Bar Franca, close to home — easy yes for a Friday that doesn't require planning.
437b015f697a.description: Midnight Lovers hosts Razor-N-Tape co-founder JKriv for a free Friday night of disco and deep house at Bar Franca in Silver Lake.

aacf17a0f1c8.title: Sorry For Party Rocking (2010-2015 Pop & Edm All Night Long!)
aacf17a0f1c8.curator_note: A 2010–2015 pop and EDM throwback night at Catch One — LMFAO-era nostalgia club, not the lane. Listed only because the venue and Pride weekend context might make it a fun wrong-turn option.
aacf17a0f1c8.description: Nostalgia DJ night at Catch One in Mid-City playing 2010–2015 pop and EDM hits all night, free before 10:30pm / $14–32 after.

7c349f4a2cfe.title: Day Trip Festival SoCal Preparty with Green Velvet and Ugo Banchi

artist_notes.name: Green Velvet
artist_notes.note: Chicago house and techno legend (Curtis Jones) — Cajual and Relief Records founder, 'La La Land' and 30+ years of funky, acid-laced tech-house. A genuine originator, not just festival filler.

artist_notes.name: Ugo Banchi
artist_notes.note: Italian/Paris-based DJ-producer who debuted on Diynamic (Solomun's label) — fluid across house and techno with an organic, emotionally textured production style; building a profile on the European club circuit.

7c349f4a2cfe.description: Day Trip Festival SoCal preparty at Exchange LA with Chicago house legend Green Velvet and Italian/French producer Ugo Banchi, 10pm–late.

221fd89985fd.title: BAILE WORLD Pride ft Bambii, Jubilee, Introspekt, & More

artist_notes.name: Bambii
artist_notes.note: Jamaican-Canadian DJ/producer (Toronto) — Juno Award winner for Electronic Album of the Year (Infinity Club EP, Polaris shortlisted); sets merge jungle, UK garage, dancehall, reggaetón, house and Miami bass into a borderless, high-energy club language. One of the most distinctive selectors in global club music right now.

artist_notes.name: Jubilee
artist_notes.note: NYC via Miami — veteran underground DJ (Mixpak) specialising in Miami bass, jersey club, Baltimore, 2-step, grime and North American regional sounds. Foundational to the cosmopolitan bass-club world Baile World inhabits.

artist_notes.name: Introspekt
artist_notes.note: LA-based, NTS resident — UK garage-rooted bass club music with a femme-forward perspective; Mixmag breakthrough DJ of 2023, DGTL and FWD>> bookings. She's local and brings a very different gear to the lineup.

artist_notes.name: Cquestt
artist_notes.note: Co-founder of Baile World itself — LA-based Afro-Latina DJ-curator behind the QTBIPOC party series highlighting global club music from reggaetón to baile funk. The host and anchor of this night.

artist_notes.name: Spiñorita
artist_notes.note: Baile World affiliate DJ; limited public record beyond the party circuit — included per the billing.

221fd89985fd.curator_note: Bambii and Jubilee together is a seriously good Pride lineup — this is global bass with actual curatorial conviction, not a generic circuit party. Baile World's TBA-DTLA format keeps it underground even with names at this level.
221fd89985fd.description: BAILE WORLD's Pride edition at a TBA DTLA location with a stacked global-bass lineup: Toronto's Bambii, NYC's Jubilee, LA's Introspekt, and Baile World co-founder Cquestt, 11pm.

0716b886d8b1.title: REVERB: VOLTIQUE PRIDE

artist_notes.name: BUCK/OFF
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Reverb party brand — moves between Chicago-style soulful house and late-night tech-house; a fixture at Catch One, Los Globos and Avalon Hollywood as well as the queer underground warehouse circuit. This is his party, so he's headlining on home turf.

artist_notes.name: masato
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ appearing in the queer underground techno/house circuit; limited public footprint beyond local event listings — included per the billing.

0716b886d8b1.curator_note: Reverb is BUCK/OFF's own party so he'll play a proper set rather than a slot — Pride weekend, TBA location, tech-house energy. More about the room and the community than the names, but that's the point of these nights.
0716b886d8b1.description: Reverb's VOLTIQUE Pride edition at a TBA DTLA location with BUCK/OFF and masato, 11pm.

8f92356359e6.title: Amore Disco Pride Edition

artist_notes.name: Aiden Ramos
artist_notes.note: LA-based vinyl collector and house DJ — Amore Disco resident, with Dublab appearances; sets bridge Balearic, Italo, deep house and rare disco. An avid digger with international dates in Berlin and Barcelona behind him, but primarily rooted in the LA scene.

8f92356359e6.curator_note: Amore Disco at Apotheke is a reliable low-key disco hang, and Aiden Ramos is the kind of vinyl-led selector the series was built around. Pride edition adds a queer-friendly room to the usual crowd — an easy Chinatown stop before or after something bigger.
8f92356359e6.description: Amore Disco's Pride edition at Apotheke in Chinatown with resident Aiden Ramos spinning disco, Balearic and deep house from vinyl, 9:30pm.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caff\u00e9.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

Riordan.note: Spotify core-rotation artist for Ari — included per the scoring signal; bio not verified independently.
